description: Land Acquisition - Jaffna Town, D/S Division, Jaffna, Malaththawal, Wellawaya D/S Division, Monaragala  District and An Amendment of D/S Division, Minipe, Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1840/37 of 12.12.2013
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes (including the Uma Oya Multipurpose Development Project), including lot numbers, land names, claimants, and exact measurements. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories taking precedence.
